retained_failures.qualification: Both remain failed observations. The unchanged timed-out files pass in isolation and in the complete exact-source hosted suite. No timeout, assertion, source, dependency, or selection relaxation is used; no proven CPU root cause is claimed.

ADR-0037.coverage: Ordinary sync/async finite prefix and tail surround the native source/operator graph; durable receipts skip completed work; prefix, document-200 and tail-loss cuts retain TaskRun/channel identities; partial collection and unsupported mid-graph calls fail closed; real 500-document HTTP/PostgreSQL/process evidence passes.

ADR-0038.coverage: Immutable deployment declaration, actual ProcessWorker launch, one-use private bootstrap, same-host Linux identity verification, real 120-second renewal horizon, competing replacement workers, drain/cancel, startup and retry-exhaustion retirement, bounded resource controls and release are exercised with ordinary regressions retained.

ADR-0039.coverage: Authenticated bounded projections, TaskRun links, unavailable/released states, generation-bound drain/cancel controls, safe error handling, accessibility/layout fixtures, actual packaged API/UI bytes and no-response-mock browser observations pass.

ADR-0040.coverage: The combined SDK/server/PostgreSQL/worker/UI path, recovery boundaries, lifecycle controls, migrations, SQLite refusal/profile behavior, compatibility, strict types, retained failures and source-bound hosted successors satisfy the common acceptance matrix.

ADR-0041.coverage: Queued and in-flight layout, late leaves/clusters, subscriptions, fetch/poll generations and unpublished Application initialization are owner-fenced. The corrected real probe observes through browser close, the injected late error fails, and complete hosted/local UI gates pass.

accepted_scope.earned_share: 100% of the explicitly bounded Native integration epoch 1 foundation
accepted_scope.profile: One versioned mixed Flow with a finite prefix, one finite linear source/operator graph and finite tail; ordinary Prefect SDK/server/deployment/ProcessWorker/UI surfaces; PostgreSQL 17 native mutations; paired schema and fail-closed SQLite behavior; trusted same-host Linux worker replacement using verified process identity.
accepted_scope.external_effects: Application-owned idempotence remains required; platform atomicity covers its documented record/state/cursor and finite receipt boundaries only.

not_claimed: Arbitrary DAG, branch, fan-out, join, parallel partitions or general streaming feature parity
Cross-host, container, hostile-worker or multi-tenant recovery
Production HA, unbounded retention, online GC or throughput/latency/memory SLO
Multi-sink atomic external effects or client-independent idempotency
A native 72-hour campaign; the historical sequential prototype campaign is not native-product load proof
Settlement of every historical stopped prerequisite wait Promise or a general UI memory/performance guarantee
